question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word ‘Swap’ from the given sentence.

The original buyer attempted to resell the tickets online because there was no option to exchange them for a new date.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Swap"** means to exchange one thing for another. (बदलना)

 
 
• **Example: **They decided to swap seats for a better view of the stage.
 
 
 
• **"Exchange"** also means to give something and receive something of the same kind in return. (विनिमय)
 
 
• **Example: **She exchanged her old phone for a new one.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **"Swap"** is **"Exchange"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Resell** (पुनः बिक्री करना): To sell something that one has previously bought.

 
 
• **Example:** He plans to resell the car at a higher price.
 
 
 
• **Original** (मूल): Existing from the beginning, not a copy or imitation.
 
 
• **Example: **The original painting was much more vibrant than the reproduction.
 
 
 
• **Option** (विकल्प): A choice or possibility available.
 
 
• **Example:** We have several options for our vacation destination.
